overview: InputTextArea is a styled wrapper around the native `<textarea>` element, providing consistent border, background, typography, and state colors aligned with the Packets design system. It supports error styling, a branded rounded variant, and configurable resize behavior.

whenToUse: Use InputTextArea for comment fields, description inputs, or any other context where multiple lines of text are expected
Use it when the user may need to review or edit longer passages of text
do: Wrap in InputRow to attach a visible label and display validation messages
Set resize="vertical" when only vertical resizing makes layout sense; set resize="none" in fixed-height layouts
Pass error as a boolean or string to trigger the error border and shadow
dont: Don't use InputTextArea for single-line inputs - use PktsInputText for that purpose
Don't rely on the resize handle as the only way to indicate to users that the field can hold more text - use a visible row count or min-height
